requirement: Update one dosage of an antibiotic: the antibiotic must exist and own the dosage, the updated dosages must still satisfy the antibiotic's dosage rules (one standard dose per route, non-overlapping CrCl ranges), then the dosage is mapped and saved.

preconditions.text: A live antibiotic exists for the target ID and owns the requested dosage
The updated dosage keeps one standard dose per route and non-overlapping CrCl ranges
The target antibiotic is a control antibiotic that does not own the dosage
The target antibiotic is unknown or already soft-deleted

inputs.text: Change the oral standard dose text to 875 mg every 12 hours
Move the adjusted dose from [30, 45] to (45, 60], touching without overlapping
Move the only standard dose from Oral to Intravenous
Update request with an unknown antibiotic ID
Update request on an antibiotic that is already soft-deleted
Update request with a dosage ID owned by another antibiotic
Clear the CrCl of the oral adjusted dose, creating a second oral standard dose
Move the adjusted dose to [45, 60], which overlaps the existing [60, 75] at 60

returns.text: Success with Updated status; route, dose text, and CrCl are persisted
UpdatedAt is refreshed and the dosage stays linked to its antibiotic
Failure with BadRequest when the antibiotic is missing, deleted, or does not own the dosage
Failure with BusinessRuleViolation when the update would break a dosage rule
Rejected updates leave the stored dosage untouched

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every rejection is returned as a failed Result
